entities.name: Filip Chlapík
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Filip Chlapík is a Czech professional ice hockey player who is a forward for HC Sparta Praha of the Czech Extraliga (ELH). Chlapík was selected 48th overall by the Ottawa Senators in the 2015 NHL entry draft. Chlapík played 57 games with the Senators in the National Hockey League (NHL) before moving in 2021 to play in Europe.
